purpose: Implementation planning coverage, not a compatibility result or test certificate

reference.sourceLicense: SolidCore: Apache-2.0; SolidCraft code: MIT OR Apache-2.0; UI/brand have separate terms

statusMeaning.partial: Some related local capability exists; no API or behavior parity claimed
statusMeaning.missing: No implementation of the named responsibility found in the inspected local source

localBaseline.scope: Working branch including subsequent record milestone changes beyond the recorded baseline; not necessarily merged main or published npm

modules.gap: Exact rational/algebraic arithmetic exists; general rounded intervals, transcendental enclosures and certified approximation policy are not implemented.
Exact vectors, planes and cylinders exist; a complete analytic surface family and common transform/placement API are missing.
Positive rational weights, evaluation, derivatives, knot insertion, split and reversal exist; general fitting, degree editing and broad imported data coverage are missing.
Versioned exact geometry/topology/region records and supported analytic bounded face definitions exist. General NURBS/procedural domains and independent pcurve correspondence remain missing.
Native, NURBS and mixed native/cylinder-SSI edge incidence exists; bounded curved face domains, geometric orientation, global embedding and common mixed Body persistence remain incomplete.

Supported native/mixed analytic face domains reconstruct from raw records and bind complete oriented boundaries, including both plane-cut cylinder-expression children. Arbitrary imported face/shell embedding, void containment, independent pcurves and NURBS face conversion remain missing.

Box, finite/clipped Cylinder, vertical Extrude, planar materials, manifold finite-cylinder expressions and repeated halfspace-clipped expressions share owned Body records, derived regions, bounded-face queries and replay-checked persistence. Restored cylinder-family Bodies can append cuts. Clipped-leaf Boolean reuse, general curved operations, arbitrary record-to-solid certification and feature history remain missing.
A common axis-aligned Box/finite Cylinder API and vertical profile Extrude exist. Complete sphere/cone/torus/pyramid constructors and broader placements remain missing.

Owned cylinder walls and planar caps support multi-cylinder/plane arrangements, exact side vectors and bounded-domain replay. Arbitrary NURBS spatial face topology and general curved trimming remain incomplete.

Native analytic and existing NURBS intersections coexist with owned cylinder SSI graphs, exact plane trims and third-cylinder SSI recovery. Finite-cylinder expression plane sections and closed cut boundaries exist. General analytic/NURBS SSI, complete contact relations and broader clipped-material operations remain incomplete.

Finite-cylinder wall/cap partitions select and sew balanced native/SSI Boolean boundaries with supported common Body persistence. Shared bounded native curve events retain source indexes; upstream cuts feed native and mixed sewing. Finite coplanar lines/conic arcs now enter the common planar strip decomposition, including finite face sections and dangling endpoints. Artificial vertical edges remain. General curved face insertion, complete material-side certification, repeated general curved cuts and maximal consolidation remain incomplete. Owned open planar cells now undergo complete plane/cylinder support-zero checks before two-sided material evaluation and oriented boundary selection/sewing. A finite cylinder cap/wall reconstruction verifies closed incidence; general curved-side selection, global coverage and embedded solid adoption remain incomplete. Missing planar support cuts can now be inserted automatically with reclassification and parent-cell provenance; generic curved refinement and full solid adoption remain incomplete. All candidate planar supports of owned cylinder/halfspace material now share partition, zero checking, refinement, material selection and sewing, with coincident support origins retained. Focused cases close against curved sides and validate an all-planar box through common Body replay; generic curved boundary extraction and global solid certification remain incomplete.

Owned planar and finite-cylinder material supports exact queries, shell regions and common Body replay, including repeated halfspace clipping. Bounded cylinder/plane predicates now preserve operand-local cuts through common Body Booleans, derived regions, complete domain persistence and replay/reuse. Nonmanifold material remains lower-level only. An exact six-plane box bridge now composes with cylinder materials at the kernel boundary layer. Native owned/restored Box Bodies now compose with cylinder-family Bodies through booleanMixedBodies3 and replayable material recipes. An owned convex single-shell planar-material bridge now derives exact supporting halfspaces; actual convex planar/consolidated Body sources now enter mixed Booleans with complete replay. General owned planar material now also compiles from physical-plane chambers and constructs sewn boundaries with common Body replay; focused cases include concavity, nested cavities/islands/disconnected shells and through-holes. Native planar/consolidated mixed Body dispatch uses convex supports or chambers; five focused native concave/disconnected/void/empty composition, replay and repeated-cut cases passed. Actual owned planar pairs now dispatch to the checked native planar Boolean kernel with focused regularized shared-plane contact, replay and subsequent cylinder-reuse checks. Actual owned/restored straight-profile product Extrude now lowers through exact planar conversion, including through-hole and reversed real-cylinder composition in focused tests. Actual normalized circular-loop product Extrude now lowers to finite-cylinder parity with owned product provenance and exact full-circle coverage checks, including annuli, islands/disconnected components and non-unit-axis spatial composition in focused cases. General arc-line and different-circle arc product lowering remains incomplete. Broader mixed contact coverage, maximal curved consolidation and general analytic/NURBS Booleans remain incomplete. Exact two-sided straight germs of planes/cylinders are shared with material boundary queries; these point germs do not certify a whole partition cell.
Vertical line/circular-profile extrusion exists; general revolve, path sweep, loft and procedural definitions are missing.
No general fillet/chamfer or rolling-ball construction.
No general surface offset or solid shell/thickness operation.
No general imported-body healing or tolerance-aware repair.

Owned rational planar material now supports exact volume, centroid and unit-density origin/central inertia, including cavities, islands, disconnected material, native/wrapped planar Body variants and replayed Boolean results in focused cases. Curved-body volume/area/centroid/inertia, general surface area and certified integration remain incomplete.

Common owned constructed Body and bounded-face membership exist alongside earlier classifiers. Factory-restored mixed plane/cylinder boundaries support exact rational forward rays and closed locally manifold shell parity with explicit degeneracy/retry. Global shell embedding/material certification, algebraic-origin/general NURBS rays, general distances and closest points remain missing.
Planar polygon triangulation and polygon extrusion meshes exist; watertight analytic/NURBS face tessellation with bounds is missing.
No STEP importer/exporter or assembly translation.
Geometry primitives exist; constraint solving and a parameterized sketch document are missing.
No feature history, parameter expression evaluation or incremental regeneration.
No shared command/session API, CLI command catalog or MCP integration.
Desktop/browser application, assemblies and product workflows remain later scope; no UI reuse is planned.
